diagram_candidates.verdict: pedagogically warranted optional diagram; not a defect or proof requirement
diagram_candidates.kind: TikZ planar annulus and Brownian boundary-hitting schematic
diagram_candidates.source_claim: For planar Brownian motion started at x, with 0 < epsilon < |x-y| < R, the probability of hitting the inner circle centered at y before the outer circle is (log R - log|x-y|)/(log R - log epsilon). The proof sets H=S_epsilon wedge T_R and evaluates log|Z_H-y| on the boundary.
diagram_candidates.why: The source is intrinsically geometric: two concentric stopping boundaries and a start point determine which boundary is reached first. A compact schematic helps orient epsilon, |x-y|, R, S_epsilon and T_R while the logarithmic formula remains the rigorous result.
diagram_candidates.specific_content: Draw an annulus centered at y, mark inner radius epsilon and outer radius R, place x at radius |x-y|, and show a representative continuous path until its first boundary hit. Label S_epsilon and T_R and indicate the event S_epsilon<T_R. Do not imply a typical path, directional drift, or rely on the sketch to prove the probability formula.
diagram_candidates.certainty: optional pedagogical candidate; source-supported, not a defect
diagram_candidates.local_image_evidence: screenshots/lem-planar-brownian-annular-exit-probability--01.png through --04.png show the source-rendered statement and proof without a diagram
